title: Red Dog
tagline: Every town needs a dog like this.
about: The true-ish story of a wandering red kelpie who united a mining town in the Pilbara.
cue: Serve the mains when the miners at the pub start telling Red Dog stories.

Kids and dogs welcome on the verandah. Red Dog the kelpie. Prices subject to change. Licence 2011.
